newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony hit by selling for fiscal year-end.
newsitem.headline: Sony hit by selling for fiscal year-end.

text.p: Sony Corp fell in early Friday morning Tokyo trade as investors continued to sell the shares in order to beef up their account books ahead of the fiscal year-end on March 31, brokers said.
As of 0041 GMT, the shares were down 100 yen at 8,610.
"There are institutional investors who are interested in buying shares of blue chips such as Sony, which have solid business forecasts," a "Big Four" broker said.
"But Thursday was a holiday and the weekend is practically here, and that is holding back buyers today," the broker added.
